::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customers/{cus}/promotional_credits"}
#docs
`closing_balance_minor` is the balance in that currency after the movement. `credit_type`/`reference` are null on movements that were not annotated. Filters: `type[is|in]=increment|decrement`, `credit_type[…]`, `currency[…]`, `created_at[after|before|on|between|…]`; paging with `limit`/`starting_after`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |

| `cus` | `string` | **yes** | Customer id (cus_…) |

| `total` | `integer` | Count of the filtered set. First page only. |
